name: blob-solutions/woocommerce-vcr-am-phpcs-bin
description: Isolated composer-bin context for PHPCS with the WordPress and PHPCompatibility sniffs, which reproduce WooCommerce QIT's Security and PHPCompatibility tests. Versions are exact because this context has no committed lock and a new sniff release would otherwise fail CI on a tree that did not change. PHPCompatibility 10 is still alpha, but it is the line that knows PHP 8.x, and QIT itself runs its develop branch.
